data.description:
## Problem statement

The ruff linter reports four RUF059 violations (unpacked variables never used)
in `skill/implement/tests/test_start_base_resolution.py`. Prefix the unused
variables with an underscore to silence the warnings.

## Users

- **Maintainers**: The linter suite must pass cleanly; unused-variable warnings
  add noise and mask genuine issues.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. All four RUF059 violations in `test_start_base_resolution.py` are resolved by
   prefixing the unused unpacked variable with an underscore (`base` → `_base`,
   `remote` → `_remote`).
2. The full test suite (`pytest`) passes without errors.
3. The full ruff linter (`ruff check`) reports zero RUF059 warnings in the file.

## Impact

Test file linter noise is reduced and the ruff + pytest gates pass cleanly on
this file.

## Constraints

- This is a pure mechanical fix — only variable names change. No logic is
  altered.
- All affected lines and their surrounding context must be reviewed to confirm
  the variables are genuinely unused.

## Existing state

Ruff reports four RUF059 errors:

| Line | Unused variable |
|------|----------------|
| 119  | `base`         |
| 136  | `remote`       |
| 323  | `remote`       |
| 379  | `remote`       |

The original work-item description only cited line 107, which no longer matches
the actual violations.

## Key Files

- `skill/implement/tests/test_start_base_resolution.py` — four variable prefixes
  to apply.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Scope creep risk:** This item covers only RUF059 in this single file. Any
  other linter issues in the file (e.g. F841, F401) should be tracked as
  separate items.
- **Assumption:** The four variables are genuinely unused. A quick grep of each
  variable name after the assignment line confirms this — no downstream
  references exist in the affected test functions.

## Related work

- SA-0MWFSGW52003YZA3 — similar RUF059 refactor in a different test file.
- SA-0MWCGH0FF009Q8Y0 — similar RUF059 refactor in a different test file.
- SA-0MU0X9CRI009QKKK — parent quality-improvement refactoring epic.
